description:
A partner has sent a raw CAD export of a proprietary airfoil ('Project_Falcon_Foil') in a non-standard CSV format. The file is located at '~/Documents/incoming/project_falcon_foil.csv'. QBlade cannot import this file directly.

Your task is to:
1. Open and inspect the CSV file.
2. Create a cleaned version (standard Selig format: Name on line 1, X Y coordinates on subsequent lines, whitespace separated, no commas/indices/Z-values).
3. Import the cleaned airfoil into QBlade's Airfoil Design module.
4. Verify the shape looks correct (it is an S809 profile).
5. Save the QBlade project as '~/Documents/projects/falcon_design.wpa'.
